message.content: Jordan from design mentioned in #design-reviews that they left a few editorial comments on one of the onboarding docs in Drive. Small fixes, typos, that kind of thing. Can you go through and apply them, then resolve each comment? Don't change anything else.

content.text: I'll track down the onboarding doc Jordan mentioned and handle the comments. Let me start by checking the #design-reviews Slack channel for context and searching Drive for onboarding docs simultaneously.
